steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Thank you... Thank you so much...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not safe here. You should hurry and leave.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Leave...?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Where... would we go?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: This was a place we could call home... But it's all ruined now...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: It's not your fault...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: It's not...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I didn't expect Reunion, the self-proclaimed savior of the Infected, to attack other Infected.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Now that... is what I call bad publicity.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This Reunion infiltration did not just occur spontaneously.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm sure there were many Infected here who chose to follow Reunion.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ugh... They'd rather trust Reunion over Rhodes Island--

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Rhodes Island does not give empty promises.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: There are many Infected who are willing to accept whatever Reunion offers, even if it's nothing more than an illusion.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: There are few who can see through the illusion.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And among those who can, most are willing to give up everything just for that vague glimmer of hope.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Who would choose to believe our little bunny, who is too kind to deceive others?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I believe her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misha...?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Nnh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Be careful! You can't move around yet!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I'm just a bit dizzy... Don't worry.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Is Reunion... still chasing us?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I don't know what they want from me...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Let's go...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's leave right away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Shortly, we'll be able to exit the slums and meet up with the L.G.D.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you, Misha.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I... should be thanking you.
